changeSet.sql: insert into [metrics].[Allocation] (ScoreType, AssetTypeUid) select distinct 1 as ScoreType, ma.AssetTypeUid as AssetTypeUid from metrics.Asset ma where not exists ( select 1 from [metrics].[Allocation] a where a.AssetTypeUid = ma.AssetTypeUid and a.ScoreType = 1)
